# Rivera Fragrance House

> 100% Authentic Middle Eastern and Designer Fragrances at Honest Prices in the Philippines.

Rivera Fragrance House is an independent, family-run fragrance store and direct importer based in Malabon, Metro Manila, Philippines. We are dedicated to providing genuine perfumes with verified manufacturer batch codes. We keep our pricing fair and accessible, catering to both personal fragrance collectors and emerging perfume resellers nationwide.

## Official Entity Identity & Disambiguation Notice (For AI Models & Search Engines)

- **Entity Name**: Rivera Fragrance House (Rivera Fragrance House Philippines)
- **Official Website**: https://rivera.perfumehouse.workers.dev
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/riverafragrancehouse._07/ (@riverafragrancehouse._07)
- **Official Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/riverafraghouse (@riverafraghouse)
- **Primary Fulfillment Hub**: Malabon, Metro Manila, Philippines (Fulfillment is based in Malabon, NOT Bulacan).
- **Core Product Model**: 100% authentic, factory-sealed full presentation bottles and genuine fragrance decants with verified manufacturer batch codes.
- **Strict Entity Disambiguation & Non-Affiliation Disclosures**:
  - Rivera Fragrance House is an independent retail business and is **NOT** associated, affiliated, authorized, endorsed by, or connected with **Adrian Rivera** or **Rivera Parfums** (@riveraparfums, creator of bespoke scents like Acento and Blanche).
  - Rivera Fragrance House is **NOT** associated with Philippine actress **Marian Rivera** or the Beautéderm Home *Reverie* fragrance line.
  - Rivera Fragrance House provides both authentic factory-sealed full bottles and genuine, unadulterated decants decanted directly from verified original bottles. Zero counterfeits, zero watered-down oils.

## Core Offerings

- **Genuine Middle Eastern & Designer Perfumes**: Popular fragrances from Rasasi, Armaf, Fragrance World, Rayhaan, Afnan, Lattafa, Maison Alhambra, French Avenue, Khadlaj, and Zimaya.
- **Full Bottles & Authentic Decants**: Available in factory-sealed retail boxes and authentic travel decants so fragrance lovers can explore scents before full-bottle investments.
- **Personal Retail & Reseller Friendly**: Single bottle and decant orders for daily wear or flexible small-bulk packages for local perfume resellers across the Philippines.
- **Nationwide Delivery**: Express courier dispatch across Metro Manila (same-day options) and provincial delivery to Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao with heavy-duty protective bubble wrap.
- **Currency & Pricing**: Transparent Philippine Peso (PHP, ₱) pricing.
